lines.text: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD for offering unauthorized fire, so only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during Aaron's lifetime.
The LORD told Moses to present the tribe of Levi to Aaron, and they were to care for the Tent's furnishings.
Levi's sons were Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and the Kohathites were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
For the 273 extra firstborn, Moses collected ten shekels each and gave the money to Aaron and his sons.
